title: Lucky Egg Guide
summary: The Lucky Egg system, its published rates and how to use Lucky Mileage.

blocks.text: Lucky Eggs are random-reward items that can give equipment, costumes, Shadow Gear, consumables and more.
The contents and rates of every Lucky Egg are published in the wiki.

items: See the Lucky Eggs on sale now
See the Lucky Eggs no longer on sale
Every item and rate is published

blocks.text: Using Lucky Eggs earns Lucky Mileage for each egg used. Exchange your mileage for various rewards at the Lucky Mileage Shop.

items: 1 Lucky Mileage for each Lucky Egg used
Lucky Mileage cannot be traded, dropped, sold, mailed or moved to guild storage.
The Lucky Mileage Shop is an in-game NPC.
The Mileage Shop's items may change with the season and the server situation.

blocks.title: About the Mileage Shop
blocks.text: Check the Mileage Shop's items and the amounts needed at the Exchange Machine in game.
Lucky Egg contents change with the server stage and the roadmap.
Lucky Eggs run in seasons, and a new season can add new contents.

blocks.title: Linked to the roadmap
blocks.text: New equipment, Shadow Gear, costumes and Enchant Stones are added step by step as the server roadmap progresses.

blocks.title: Lucky Eggs no longer on sale
blocks.text: Lucky Eggs whose sale has ended are merged into the [ITEM:12610|Mysterious Egg], which gives one random Lucky Egg from those sold in the past.
